**Subject: Topic classifier – test results**

Hi [Advisor],

Here are the test-set results for the DistilRoBERTa topic classifier (5 classes, 1,000 test examples):

| Run | Test accuracy | Test macro-F1 |
|---|---|---|
| baseline (lr 3e-5, bs 32, no aug) | 0.806 | 0.805 |
| aug (lr 3e-5, bs 32, aug p=0.3) | 0.829 | 0.828 |
| aug-lr (lr 1e-4, bs 64, aug p=0.3) | n/a, crashed | n/a, crashed |

- **aug beats baseline by about 2.3 points** on both accuracy and macro-F1. It improves classes 0–3; class 4 is the weakest class in both runs and doesn't improve (F1 ≈ 0.74).
- **aug-lr didn't finish.** It ran out of GPU memory during epoch 7 at batch size 64, so it has no test predictions. Its validation accuracy was 0.839 after epoch 6, but we can't compare that to aug's 0.847 because aug got there at its best epoch (9).
- **Recommendation: go with aug.** It's the best run we have finished. If we want to test the higher learning rate, we can rerun aug-lr at batch size 32, or use gradient accumulation to keep the effective batch at 64.

Note: the results table in the repo README (dated Sep 12) is out of date. It reports higher numbers (0.884 / 0.913 accuracy) that don't match these runs.

Best,
